rationale.edition: All seven changed paths live under web/src/** (web/src/lib/core/Button/*, web/src/lib/core/VirtualScroll/*, web/src/plugins/logs/*). None are under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/, or any enterprise-gated module, and no enterprise keywords (SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/cipher/logo-management) appear in the paths or changed symbols. Classified as OSS.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are both empty, so there is no explicit tests-added label or skip request. The change alters user-facing .vue components (SearchResult.vue, OButton.vue, OVirtualScroll.vue), so it is not a docs/CI/comment-only change.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The change alters user-exercisable behavior in the Logs search results view: a fresh patterns extraction now scrolls the shared container to top, the virtual scroller preserves its offset when rows are remeasured, and the button loading wrapper keeps display:contents to avoid stranding a child tooltip at (0,0). These are real interaction/state changes a user can hit, not internal-only refactors.
rationale.area: Area is Logs. The primary user-facing change is in web/src/plugins/logs/SearchResult.vue, with the OVirtualScroll and OButton core-component fixes supporting that logs view. Sibling E2E specs live under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/.
rationale.group: playwright_group Logs-Core is the closest existing OSS shard: its actual_folder is Logs and its run_files already cover search-result/logs behavior (logspage.spec.js, logsAnalyzeDimensions.spec.js, shareLink.spec.js).
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The changed OButton.spec.ts, OVirtualScroll.spec.ts, and SearchResult.spec.ts are Vitest unit tests, not Playwright specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/. existing_tests_in_diff is false.
